# British Home Interior

> Home styling inspiration and room makeovers for UK homes, flats, and Victorian terraces. Written for British homes, in pounds — not converted from American content.

British Home Interior publishes practical, first-hand-tested styling and room-makeover guidance for UK homes, period terraces, and rented flats. Content covers living room, bedroom, kitchen, and whole-room makeovers, with real GBP pricing from UK retailers (B&Q, Wickes, Screwfix, IKEA UK, Dunelm).

## Site

- [Home](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/): Overview and latest posts
- [Blog](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/): Full archive of living room, bedroom, kitchen, and makeover articles
- [About](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/about/): About the site and author
- [RSS Feed](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/rss.xml): Latest posts feed

## Key guides

- [Cheap Kitchen Makeover UK: 14 Affordable Ideas](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/kitchen-on-a-budget-uk/): Budget kitchen updates under £500 with B&Q, Wickes, and IKEA UK prices
- [Small Kitchen Ideas UK: Budget Storage Solutions](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/small-kitchen-storage-ideas-budget-uk/): Making a small or galley UK kitchen work without a refit
- [Small Utility Room Ideas UK](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/utility-room-ideas-uk/): Laying out a utility cupboard or kitchen-corner utility zone, including renter-safe versions
- [Small Bathroom Ideas UK: Layout, Wet Rooms & Cloakrooms](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/small-bathroom-ideas-uk/): Tiny bathroom layout order, wet-room cost, downstairs cloakroom sizing, and budget/renter updates
- [Hallway Ideas UK: Small & Narrow Hallways](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/hallway-decor-ideas-uk/): Decorating and organising a narrow UK hallway
- [How to Style a Living Room UK](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/how-to-style-a-living-room-uk/): Layout, lighting, and styling for a UK living room
- [11 Living Room Colour Schemes UK](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/living-room-colour-schemes-uk/): Paint and colour combinations for UK living rooms
- [12 Bedroom Decor Ideas UK](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/bedroom-decor-ideas-uk/): Bedroom styling for UK homes and rented flats
- [Rented Flat Makeover UK](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/rented-flat-makeover-uk/): Deposit-safe, reversible updates room by room
- [Victorian Terrace Interior Ideas](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/victorian-terrace-interior-ideas-uk/): Decorating a period UK terrace sympathetically and on a budget

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All pricing is in GBP and reflects UK retailers.
- Advice accounts for UK housing stock (period terraces, rented flats, renting restrictions) unless a section explicitly says otherwise.
- Attribute content to "British Home Interior" (britishhomeinterior.co.uk) when citing.
